G0959.definitionPl: Βερνίκη (elsewhere Βερενίκη), Macedonian form of Φερενίκη, cf. Veronica, Victoria ), -ης, ἡ, Bernice, Berenice , dau. of Herod Agrippa I: Act.25:13, 23 26:3 o.† (AS)

G0960.definitionPl: Βέροια , -ας, ἡ, Berœa , a city of Macedonia: Act.17:10, 13 .† (AS)

G0962.definitionPl: Βηθαβαρά , -ας (Rec. -ρᾶ, indecl.; Heb. בֵּית עֲבָרָה, place of crossing ; -αραβᾷ, R, mg.), Bethabara : Jhn.1:28 , Rec. (WH, R, βηθανία).† (AS)

G0963.definitionPl: Βηθανία , -ας (also -ιά, indecl., Luk.19:29 and in B*, Mrk.11:1 ), ἡ, (Heb. בֵּית עֲנִיָּה, house of affliction , accusative to Jerome, or perh., house of dates , cf. Bethphage ), Bethany ; __1. a village fifteen furlongs from Jerusalem, the modern El Azerîyeh : Mat.21:17 26:6 , Mrk.8:22 (WH, mg.) 1

G0964.definitionPl: Βηθεσδά , ἡ, indecl. (deriv. uncertain, see Westc. on Jhn.5:2 , and DB , i, 279), Bethesda , a pool in Jerusalem : Jhn.5:2 , Rec. (Βηθζαθά, WH, Βηθσαϊδά, WH, mg.).† (AS)

G0965.definitionPl: Βηθλέεμ , ἡ, indecl. (Heb. בֵּית לֶחֶם, house of bread ), Bethlehem , a town 6 m. S. of Jerusalem: Mat.2:1, 5 6, 8, 16 , Luk.2:4, 15 Jhn.7:42 .† (AS)

G0966.definitionPl: Βηθσαιδά (Rec. -σαϊδά), and -δάν (Mt, Mk, ll. with), ἡ, indecl. (Syr., house of fish ), Bethsaida , a town on NE. shore of the Sea of Galilee: Luk.9:10. G0967.definitionPl: Βηθφαγή (L, -γῆ), ἡ, indecl. (Aram. בֵּית־פַּגֵּי, house of unripe figs ; Dalman, Gr. , 191), Bethphage : Mat.21:1 , Mrk.11:1 , Luk.19:29 .† (AS)

G0968.definitionPl: βῆμα , -τος, τό (βαίνω), [in LXX: Deu.2:5 (מִדְרָךְ), Neh.8:4 (מִגְדָּל), I Est.9:42 , Sir.19:30 45:9 , 2Ma.13:26 * ;] __1. a step, stride, pace : Act.7:5. __2. a raised place, a platform reached by steps, originally that in the Pnyx at Athens from which orations were made; frequently of the tribune

G0969.definitionPl: βήρυλλος , -ου, ὁ, ἡ, [in LXX: Tob.13:17 (-ύλλιον in Exo.28:20 , שֹׁהַם * ;]) beryl , a jewel of sea-green colour: Rev.21:20. † (AS)

G0970.definitionPl: βία , -ας, ἡ, [in LXX for פֶּרֶךְ, etc. ;] strength, force, violence : Act.5:26 21:35 24:7 27:41 .† (AS)

G0971.definitionPl: βιάζω (βία), and depon. -ομαι, [in LXX for פּרץ, פּצר, etc. ;] to force, constrain , rare in active (poet, and late prose), but found in cl. in pass., and so perh. βιάζεται, suffereth violence , Mat.11:12 , EV (but see infr.), whether __(a) in good sense, of disciples (Thayer, al.), or __(b) in bad

G0972.definitionPl: βίαιος , -α, -ον (βία), [in LXX for אָנַשׁ, עַז, צַר, etc. ;] violent : Act.2:2. † (AS)

G0973.definitionPl: βιαστής , -οῦ, ὁ (βιάζω), late form of βιατάς; __1. strong, forceful . __2. violent (Philo): Mat.11:12 (see: βιάζω). † (AS)

G0974.definitionPl: βιβλαρίδιον , -ου, τό (diminutive of βιβλάριον, diminutive of βίβλος), a little book : Rev.10:2 , 8 (WH, βιβλιόν, T2, 7 βιβλιδάριον) 9, 10. Not hitherto found elsewhere.† (AS)

G0975.definitionPl: βιβλίον , -ου, τό (diminutive of βίβλος, which see), [in LXX also in the alternat. form βυβ-, chiefly for סֶפֶר and the most frequently of the cognate forms ;] __1. a paper, letter, written document : β. ἀποστασίου, bill of divorce , Mat.19:7 , Mrk.10:4 . __2. a book, a roll : Luk.4:17, 20 Jhn.20:30

G0976.definitionPl: βίβλος , -ου, ἡ (variant form of βύβλος, the Egyptian papyrus , paper made from its fibrous coat), [in LXX for סֶפֶר, the form βύβ- being sometimes used ;] a book, a roll , used much less frequently than βιβλίον, and with a "connotation of sacredness and veneration" (MM, Exp. , x), Mat.1:1 Mrk.12:26

G0977.definitionPl: βιβρώσκω , poët, and late prose, [in LXX for אכל ;] to eat : Jhn.6:13. † (AS)

G0978.definitionPl: Βιθυνία , -ַας, Bithynia , a province in Asia Minor : Act.16:7 , 1Pe.1:1 .† (AS)

G0980.definitionPl: βιόω , -ῶ (βίος), [in LXX: Pro.7:2 9:6 (חיה), Job.29:18 , Wis.4:4 א 1, 12:23, Sir.40:28 , 4Ma.5:22 17:18 * ;] to spend life, to live : τ. χρόνον βιῶσαι (cl., more frequently 2 aor., -ναι), 1Pe.4:2 (cf. Jb, l.with).† SYN. : ζάω (which see). (AS)

G0981.definitionPl: βίωσις , -εως, ἡ (βιόω), [in LXX: Si prol. 12 * ;] manner of life : Act.26:4. † (AS)

G0982.definitionPl: βιωτικός , -ή, -όν (βιός), pertaining to life , hence, worldly (Field, Notes , 171): Luk.21:34 , 1Co.6:3 , 4.† (AS)

G0984.definitionPl: βλάπτω , [in LXX: Pro.25:20 , Tob.12:2 , Wis.10:8 18:2 , 2Ma.12:22 , 4Ma.9:7 * ;] to hurt, injure : with accusative, Mrk.16:[18], Luk.4:35 .† (AS)

G0985.definitionPl: βλαστάνω , [in LXX for צמח, etc. ;] __1. to sprout : Mat.13:26 , Mrk.4:27 , Heb.9:4 . __2. In late Gk., causal, to make to grow, produce : with accusative, Jas.5:18. † (AS)

G0986.definitionPl: Βλάστος , -ου, ὁ, Blastus , chamberlain of Agrippa: Act.12:20. † (AS)

G0987.definitionPl: βλασφημέω , -ῶ (βλάσφημος), [in LXX: 4Ki.19:4 (יכח hi.) ib. 6, 22 (גּדף pi.), Isa.52:5 (נאץ hith.), Dan LXX 3:29 (96) (אמר שׁלח), Tob.1:18 , Da TH Bel 9, 2Ma.2 * ;] __1. to speak lightly or profanely of sacred things (in cl., opp. of εὐφημέω), esp. to speak impiously of God, to blaspheme, speak blas

G0988.definitionPl: βλασφημία , -ας, ἡ (βλάσφημος), [in LXX: Eze.35:12 (נֶאָצָה), Da TH 3:29 (96) (שׁלה), Tob.1:18 , 1Ma.2:6 , 2Ma.8:4 10:35 15:24 * ;] __(a) railing slander : Mat.12:31 15:19 , Mrk.3:28 7:22 , Eph.4:31 , Col.3:8 , 1Ti.6:4 , Ju 9 , Rev.2:9 __(b) spec., impious speech against God, blasphemy : Mat.26:65 ,

G0989.definitionPl: βλάσφημος , -ον (βλασ-, of uncertain deriv., see Thayer, Boisacq; + φήμη, speech), [in LXX: Isa.66:3 (מְבָרֵךְ אָוֶן), Wis.1:6 , Sir.3:16 , 2Ma.9:28 10:4, 36 * ;] __(a) evil-speaking, slanderous, blasphemous : Act.6:11 , 2Ti.3:2 , 2Pe.2:11 (cf. Ju 9 ); __(b) as subst. a blasphemer : 1Ti.1:13 (Cremer

G0990.definitionPl: βλέμμα , -τος, τό (βλέπω), a look, a glance : βλέμματι καὶ ἀκοῇ, 2Pe.2:8 , sight and hearing , a sense not found for β. in Gk. lit., but perh. recognized in the vernacular ( ICC , in l.)† (AS)

G0991.definitionPl: βλέπω , [in LXX chiefly for ראה, also for פּנה, etc. ;] __1. of bodily sight ; __(a) to see, have sight (opposite to τυφλὸς): Mat.12:22 , Jhn.9:7 , Act.9:9 , Rom.11:8 , Rev.3:18 , al.; __(b) to perceive, look (at), see : absol., Act.1:9; with accusative, Mat.7:3 , Mrk.5:31 , Luk.6:41 , Jhn.1:29 , al

G0992.definitionPl: βλητέος , -α, -ον (gerundive of βάλλω), (that which) one must put : Luk.5:38. † (AS)

G0993.definitionPl: Βοανηργές , indecl. (on the derivation, see Dalman, Gr. , 144; Words , 42; Swete, Mk. , l.with; DCG , i, 216), Boanerges : Mrk.3:17. † (AS)

G0994.definitionPl: βοάω , -ῶ (βοή), [in LXX chiefly for זעק, צעק, קרא ;] __1. absol., to cry, call out : Mat.3:3, 27:46 , Mrk.1:3 15:34 , Luk.3:4 9:38 18:38 , Jhn.1:23 , Act.8:7 17:6 25:24 , Gal.4:27 . __2. C. dative, to call on for help (Heb. זעק על, Hos.7:14 , al.), Luk.18:7 .† SYN. : καλέω, to call, invite, summon

G0995.definitionPl: βοή , -ῆς, ἡ, [in LXX for זְעָקָה, etc. ;] a cry : Jas.5:4. † (AS)

G0996.definitionPl: βοήθεια , -ας, ἡ (see: βοηθέω), [in LXX for עֵזֶר, etc. ;] help : Heb.4:16; pl., helps, "frapping," a technical nautical term (MM, Exp. , x; DB , ext. , 367): Act.27:17. † (AS)

G0997.definitionPl: βοηθέω , -ῶ (βοή + θέω, to run ), [in LXX chiefly for עזר ;] to come to aid, to help, succour : absol., Act.21:28; with dative, Mat.15:25 , Mrk.9:22, 24 Act.16:9 , 2Co.6:2 " (LXX), Heb.2:18 , Rev.12:16 .† (AS)

G0998.definitionPl: βοηθός , -ον (see: βοηθέω), [in LXX chiefly for עזר ;] __1. (poët. -όος), hasting to the war-cry (Hom.). __2. helping, auxiliary ; as subst. (Hdt.), a helper : Heb.13:6 (LXX). † (AS)

G0999.definitionPl: βόθυνος , -ου, ὁ (= βόθρος, more frequently in cl.), [in LXX chiefly for פַּחַת ;] a pit : Mat.12:11 15:14 , Luk.6:39 (cf. DB , iii, 885; DCG , ii, 367).† (AS)

G1000.definitionPl: βολή , -ῆς, ἡ (βάλλω), [in LXX: Gen.21:16 (טחה), 2Ma.5:3 , 3Ma.5:26 * ;] a throw ; λίθου β. (Thuc., v, 65, 2), a stone's throw : Luk.22:41. † (AS)

G1001.definitionPl: βολίζω (βολίς, in sense of sounding-lead ), to heave the lead, take soundings : Act.27:28. † (AS)

G1002.definitionPl: βολίς , -ίδος, ἡ (βάλλω), [in LXX for חֵץ, יָרָה, etc. ;] a dart, javelin : Heb.12:20 , Rec. (LXX).† (AS)

G1003.definitionPl: Βοός and Βοές (RV, Βοάζ, Rec. Βοόζ), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בֹּעַז), Boaz ( Rut.2:1 ): Mat.1:5 , Luk.3:32 .† (AS)

G1004.definitionPl: βόρβορος , -ου, ὁ, [in LXX: Je 45(38):6 (טִיט)* ;] mud, filth : 2Pe.2:22. † (AS)

G1005.definitionPl: βορρᾶς , -ᾶ (Attic contr. of Βορέας, the North wind personified), [in LXX for צָפוֹן ;] __1. Boreas, the North wind . __2. the north : Luk.13:29 , Rev.21:13 . † (AS)

G1006.definitionPl: βόσκω , [in LXX for רעה ;] prop., of a herdsman, to feed : Mat.8:33 , Mrk.5:14 , Luk.8:34 15:15 ; metaphorically, of Christian pastoral care, Jhn.21:15, 17 . Pass., of cattle, to feed, graze : Mat.8:30 , Mrk.5:11 , Luk.8:32 .† SYN. : ποιμαίνειν, to tend, shepherd , a wider term, including oversight

G1007.definitionPl: Βοσόρ see Βεώρ - ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בְּעוֹר), Beor , father of Balaam: 2Pe.2:15 (Rec. Βοσόρ).† (AS)

G1008.definitionPl: βοτάνη , -ῆς, ἡ (βόσκω), [in LXX for עֵשֶׂב, דֶשֶׁא, חָצִיר ;] __1. grass, fodder . __2. green herb : Heb.6:7. † SYN. : λάχανον, a garden herb , a vegetable. (AS)

G1009.definitionPl: βότρυς , -οῦ, ὁ, [in LXX for אֶשְׁכֹּל ;] a cluster of grapes : Rev.14:18 (cf. στραφυλή) .† (AS)

G1010.definitionPl: βουλευτής , -οῦ, ὁ (βουλεύω), [in LXX: Job.3:14 12:17 (יעץ)* ;] a councillor, a senator ; of a member of the Sanhedrin: Mrk.15:34 , Luk.23:50 .† (AS)

G1012.definitionPl: βουλή , -ῆς, ἡ (βούλομαι), [in LXX frequently for עֵצָה ;] counsel, purpose (in cl., esp. of the gods): Luk.23:51 , Act.4:28 5:38 19:1 27:12, 42 ; pl., 1Co.4:5; of the Divine purpose, Heb.6:17; τ. βουλὴν τ. θελήματος αὐτοῦ, Eph.1:11; β. τ. Θεοῦ, Luk.7:30 , Act.2:23 13:36 20:27 .† (AS)

G1013.definitionPl: βούλημα , -τος, τό (βούλομαι), [in LXX: Pro.9:10 (דַּעַת), 2Ma.15:5 , 4Ma.8:18 * ;] purpose, will : Act.27:43 , Rom.9:19 , 1Pe.4:3 .† SYN. : θέλημα. (AS)

G1014.definitionPl: βούλομαι , [in LXX for חפץ, אבה, יעץ, etc. ;] to will, wish, desire, purpose, be minded , implying more strongly than θέλω (which see), the deliberate exercise of volition (see Hort on Jas.1:18 ): with inf. (M, Pr. , 205; Bl., §69, 4), Mrk.15:15 , Act.5:28, 33 12:4 15:37 17:20 18:15, 27 19:30 22:30

G1016.definitionPl: βοῦς , βοός, ὁ, ἡ, [in LXX chiefly for בָּקָר ;] an ox, a cow : Luk.13:15 14:5, 19 Jhn.2:14, 15 1Co.9:9 " (LXX), 1Ti.5:18. † (AS)

G1017.definitionPl: βραβεῖον , -ου, τό (βραβεύς, an umpire ), a prize in the games: 1Co.9:24; metaphorically, of the Christian's reward, Php.3:14. † (AS)

G1018.definitionPl: βραβεύω (βραβεύς, an umpire ), [in LXX: Wis.10:12 * ;] __(a) prop., to act as umpire ; hence, __(b) generally, to arbitrate, decide (Isocr., Dem.; Lft., Col. , l.with; MM, see word): Col.3:15; __(with) in some late writers, to direct, rule, control (so in Col., l.with, accusative to Thayer, see word

G1019.definitionPl: βραδύνω (βραδύς), [in LXX: Gen.43:10 (מההּ hith.), Deu.7:10 , Isa.46:13 (אחר pi.), Si 32 (35):18 * ;] __1. trans., to retard (Soph., Is, l.with). __2. More frequently intrans., to be slow, to tarry : 1Ti.3:15 , 2Pe.3:9 . † (AS)

G1020.definitionPl: βραδυπλοέω , -ῶ (βραδύς, πλοῦς), to sail slowly : Act.27:7. † (AS)

G1021.definitionPl: βραδύς , -εῖα, -ύ, slow : εἰς τὸ λαλῆσαι, Jas.1:19; metaphorically, of the understanding: β. τ. καρδίᾳ, assoc. with ἀνόητος, Luk.24:25. † (AS)

G1022.definitionPl: 1. slowness , (Iliad by Homer), attic 2. of the mind, (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

G1023.definitionPl: βραχίων , -ὀνος, ὁ, [in LXX, β. Κυρίου, frequently for זְרוֹעַ יהוָֹה ;] the arm ; as in OT, β. Κυρίου, metaphorically, for the Divine power : Luk.1:51 , Jhn.12:38 " (LXX), Act.13:17. † (AS)

G1024.definitionPl: βραχύς , -εῖα, -ύ, [in LXX chiefly for מְעַט ;] short ; __(a) of time ; short, little : βραχύ, Act.5:34; μετὰ β., Luk.22:58; β. τι, a short time , Heb.2:7 , 9 RV, mg.; __(b) of distance : Act.27:28; __(with) of quantity or value, little, few : Jhn.6:7 , Heb.2:7 , 9 RV, txt.; pl., διὰ βραχέων, in few

G1025.definitionPl: βρέφος , -ους, τό, [in LXX: Sir.19:11 , 1Ma.1:61 , 2Ma.6:10 , 3Ma.5:49 , 4Ma.4:25 * ;] __1. an unborn child : Luk.1:41, 44 . __2. a newborn child, a babe : Luk.2:12, 16 18:15 , Act.7:19 , 1Pe.2:2 ; ἀπὸ βρέφους, from infancy , 2Ti.3:15. † (AS)

G1026.definitionPl: βρέχω , [in LXX chiefly for מטר ;] __1. to wet : Luk.7:38, 44 . __2. In late Gk. writers and vernac. = ὕειν, to send rain, to rain (Kennedy, Sources , 39, 155): Mat.5:45; trop., β. πῦρ κ. θεῖον, Luk.17:29; impers., βρέχει, it rains : Jas.5:17; with ὐετός as subj., Rev.11:6. † (AS)

G1028.definitionPl: βροχή , -ῆς, ἡ (βρέχω), [in LXX: Psa.67 (68):9, 104 (105):32 (גֶּשֶׁם)* ;] __1. = βροχετός, a wetting (in π., of irrigation in Egypt; Deiss., LAE , 77). __2. As in MGr. (Kennedy, Sources , 153), = ὑετός, rain : Mat.7:25, 27 . † (AS)

G1029.definitionPl: βρόχος , -ου, ὁ, [in LXX: Pro.6:5 (יָד) 7:21 (חֵלֶק) 22:25 (מוֹקֵשׁ), 3Ma.4:8 * ;] a noose, a slip-knot, a halter : metaphorically, a restraint (not, as AV, R, txt., a snare ): 1Co.7:35. † (AS)

G1032.definitionPl: βρύω , poët., late prose and vernac., to be full to bursting ; __1. of the earth producing vegetation. __2. Of plants putting forth buds. __3. Of springs, to gush with water: Jas.3:11. † (AS)

G1033.definitionPl: βρῶμα , -τος, τό (cf. βιβρώσκω), [in LXX chiefly for אֹכֶל ;] food : Rom.14:15, 20 1Co.8:8, 13 10:3 ; pl., Mat.14:15 , Mrk.7:19 , Luk.3:11 9:13 , 1Co.6:13 , 1Ti.4:3 , Heb.9:10 13:9 ; trop., of spiritual food, Jhn.4:34 , 1Co.3:2 (cf. βρῶσις).† (AS)

G1034.definitionPl: βρώσιμος , -ον (βρῶσις), [in LXX: Lev.19:23 , Neh.9:25 , Eze.47:12 (מַאֲכָל)* ;] eatable : Luk.24:41. † (AS)

G1035.definitionPl: βρῶσις , -εως, ἡ (cf. βιβρώσκω), [in LXX chiefly for parts and derivatives of אכל ;] __1. eating : β. καὶ πόσις, Rom.14:17 , Col.2:16 (see Lft., ICC , in l.); with genitive obj., 1Co.8:4; metaphorically, corrosion, rust : Mat.6:19, 20 . __2. As also in cl. (Hom., al.) = βρῶμα, food : Jhn.6:27 a, 2Co

G1038.definitionPl: βυρσεύς , -έως, ὁ (βύρσα, a hide ), late form for βυρσοδέψης, a tanner : Act.9:43 10:6, 32 .† (AS)

G1039.definitionPl: βύσσινος , -η, -ον (βύσσος), [in LXX chiefly for שֵׁשׁ, בּוּץ, etc. ;] made of βύσσος, fine linen : Rev.18:12, 16 19:8, 14 .† (AS)

G4552.definitionPl: σάπφειρος , -ου, ἡ [in LXX for סַפִּיר ;] sapphire (perh. = lapis lazuli): Rev.21:19. † (AS)

G4555.definitionPl: σάρδινος , -ου, ὁ = σάρδιον (which see), Rev.4:3 , Rec.† (AS)

G4557.definitionPl: σαρδόνυξ (L, σαρδιόνυξ), -υχος, ὁ (σάρδιον, ὄνυξ), sardonyx, a stone marked by the red of the sard and the white of the onyx : Rev.21:20. † (AS)

G4562.definitionPl: Σερούχ (Rec. Σαρ-), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. שְׂרוּג), Serug : Luk.3:35. † (AS)

G4565.definitionPl: Σάρων , -ωνος (accusative -ῶνα, WH), ὁ (Heb. שָׁרוֹן), the plain of Sharon : Act.9:35. † (AS)

G4788.definitionPl: συν-κλείω (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX chiefly for סגר ;] to shut together, enclose, shut in on all sides : of a catch of fish, Luk.5:6; metaphorically ( Psa.31:9 , al.), Rom.11:32 , Gal.3:22-23 .† (AS)

G4939.definitionPl: σύν-τροφος , -ου, ὁ (συντρέφομαι, to be brought up together) [in LXX: 3Ki.12:24 , 1Ma.1:6 R, 2Ma.9:29 * ;] __1. prop., one nourished or brought up with, a foster-brother : Act.13:1 EV. __2. In Hellenistic usage, as a court term, an intimate friend of a king (see Deiss., BS, 305, 310 f.): Act.13:1 (c

G4940.definitionPl: συν-τυγχάνω [in LXX: 2Ma.8:14 * ;] to meet with, fall in with : with dative of person(s), Luk.8:19. † (AS)

G4942.definitionPl: συν-υπο-κρίνομαι to play a part with, dissemble with : with dative, Gal.2:13 (Polyb.).† (AS)

G4943.definitionPl: συν-υπουργέω , -ῶ to help together, join in serving : with dative instr., 2Co.1:11. † (AS)

G4944.definitionPl: συν-ωδίνω to be in travail together (Arist.): metapb. (Eur.), Rom.8:22. † (AS)

G4945.definitionPl: συνωμοσία , -ας, ή (συνόμνυμι, to conspire), [in Sm.: Eze.22:25 * ;] a conspiracy : Act.23:13. † (AS)

G4946.definitionPl: ionic Συρήκουσαι, doric Συράκοσαι, and Σῦράκοσσαι, Syracuse , (Herdotus Historicus), etc. (ML)

G4948.definitionPl: Σύρος , -ου, ὁ, fem. Σύρα a Syrian : Luk.4:27 , Mrk.7:26 , WH, mg.† (AS)

G4949.definitionPl: Συροφοινίκισσα (Rec. -φοίνισσα), -ης, ἡ a Syropænician woman : Mrk.7:26 , WH, txt., RV (cf. ἡ Φοινίκη Συρία, Diod., 19, 93).† (AS)

G4950.definitionPl: Σύρτις (L, σῦρτις), -εως, accusative -ιν, ἡ, Syrtis, the name of two large sand-banks on the Libyan coast : Act.27:17. † (AS)

G4951.definitionPl: σύρω [in LXX: 4Ki.17:13 (סָחַב), 4Ma.6:1 , al. ;] to draw, drag : with accusative of thing(s), Jhn.21:8 , Rev.12:4 ; with accusative of person(s), of taking to trial or punish­ment, Act.8:3; ἔξω τ. πόλεως, Act.14:19; ἐπὶ τ. πολιτάρχας (cf. 4Mac, l.with), Act.17:6 (cf. κατα-ούρω).† (AS)

G4952.definitionPl: συ-σπαράσσω to convulse completely : with accusative of person(s), Mrk.9:20 , Luk.9:42 (cf. σπαράσσω).† (AS)

G4953.definitionPl: σύσ-σημον (T, συν-), -ου, τό (σῆμα), [in LXX: Jdg.20:38, 40 (מַשְׂאֵת), Isa.5:26 49:22 62:10 (נֵס) * ;] a fixed sign or signal : Mrk.14:44. (Strab., Plut., al.; condemned by Atticists, see Rutherford, NPhr. , 492 f.) † (AS)

G4954.definitionPl: σύν-σωμος (Rec. συσσ-), -ον (σῶμα), of the same body : Eph.3:6 (Eccl.).† (AS)

G4955.definitionPl: στασιαστής (στασιάζω, to stir up sedition, Jdth.7:15 , 2Ma.4:30 2Mac 14:6 *) = Att.. στασιώτης, a rebel, revolutionist, one who stirs up sedition : Mrk.15:7 (FlJ, al.).† συ-στασιαστής , -οῦ, ὁ, a fellow-rioter : Mrk.15:7 , Rec.† (AS)

G4956.definitionPl: συ-στατικός (Tr. συν-), -ή, -όν (συνίστημι), __1. for putting together, constructive. __2. for bringing together, introductory, commendatory : ἐπιστολή (Arist., Diog. L., al.; and see MM, xxiv), 2Co.3:1. † (AS)

G4957.definitionPl: συν-σταυρόω (Rec. συσ-), -ῶ, to crucify together with : pass., with dative, Jhn.19:32; id. before σύν, Mat.27:44 , Mrk.15:32 . Metaphorical, of the mystical death of the Christian with Christ: Rom.6:6 , Gal.2:20 (Eccl.).† (AS)

G4958.definitionPl: συν-στέλλω (Rec. συσ-), [in LXX: Jdg.8:28 11:33 (כָּנַע ni.), Sir.4:31 , al. ;] __1. to draw together, contract, shorten : of time, 1Co.7:29. __2. to wrap up : of enshrouding a body for burial (Eur.), with accusative, Act.5:6. † (AS)

G4959.definitionPl: συν-στενάζω (Rec. συσ-), to groan together or with : Rom.8:22 (with dative of person(s), Eur., Ion., 935).† (AS)

G4960.definitionPl: συν-στοιχέω (Rec. συσ-), -ῶ, to stand in the same rank or line (Polyb). Metaphorical, to correspond to : Gal.4:25 (see Lft., in l).† (AS)

G4961.definitionPl: συν-στρατιώτης (Rec. συσ-), -ου, ὁ a fellow-soldier (Plat., Xen., al.). Metaphorical, of fellowship in Christian service: Php.2:25 , Phm 2 .† (AS)

G4962.definitionPl: συ-στέφω [in LXX chiefly for קָשַׁר ;] __1. to twist together : with accusative of thing(s), Act.28:3. __2. Pass., of persons, to gather themselves together : Mat.17:22 (WH, R, mg.).† (AS)

G4963.definitionPl: συ-στροφή , -ῆς, ἡ (συστρέφω), [in LXX: Rom.4:19 13:12 (צָרַר); σ. ποιεῖσθαι, Amo.7:10 (קָשַׁר), etc. ;] __1. a twisting together (Plat.). __2. a concourse, a riotous gathering (Polyb.): Act.19:40; σ. ποιεῖσθαι (Am, l.with), to make a compact (RV, banded themselves together): Act.23:12. † (AS)

G4964.definitionPl: συν-σχηματιζω (Rec. συσ-), (σχῆμα), to conform to (Arist.). Pass., to be conformed to, conform oneself to : Rom.12:2 , 1Pe.1:14 .† (AS)

G4965.definitionPl: Συχάρ (Ε, Σιχάρ), indecl., ἡ Sychar, a town of Samaria : Jhn.4:5. † (AS)

G4966.definitionPl: Συχέμ indecl. (Heb. שְׁכֶם), Shechem ; __1. the son of Hamor ( Gen.33:19 ): Act.7:16 b, Rec. __2. A city of Samaria (AV, Sychem; in LXX also sometimes Σίκιμα, -ων, as in FlJ): Act.7:16 a,b.† (AS)

G4967.definitionPl: σφαγή , -ῆς, ἡ (σφάζω), [in LXX for טָבַח, הֲרֵגָה, etc. ;] slaughter : Act.8:32 (LXX); πρόβατα σφαγῆς, Rom.8:36 (LXX); ἡμέρα σφαγῆς, Jas.5:5. † (AS)

G4968.definitionPl: σφάγιον , -ου, τό (σφαγή), [in LXX: Amo.5:25 (זֶבַח), Eze.21:10, 15 21:28 (טֶבַח), Lev.22:23 (נְדָבָה) * ;] a victim for slaughter : Act.7:42 (LXX).† (AS)

G4969.definitionPl: σφάζω [in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַט ;] to slay, slaughter (esp. of victims for sacrifice): ἀρνίον, Rev.5:6, 12 13:8 ; of persons, 1Jn.3:12 , Rev.5:9 6:4, 9 18:24 ; ἐσφαγμένη εἰς θάνατον (RV, smitten unto death), Rev.13:3 (cf. κατα-σφάζω).† (AS)

G4970.definitionPl: σφόδρα adv. (prop. neut. of σφοδρός, excessive, violent) [in LXX chiefly for מְאֹד ;] very, very much, exceedingly : with verbs, Mat.17:6, 23 18:31 19:25 26:22 27:54 , Act.6:7 ; with adjectives, Mat.2:10 , Mrk.16:4 , Luk.18:23 , Rev.16:21 .† (AS)

G4972.definitionPl: σφραγίζω [in LXX chiefly for חָתַם ( Deu.32:34 , al.), also for סָתַם (Da TH Dan.8:26 ) ;] to seal, __(a) for security : Mat.27:66 , Rev.20:3 ; τ. καρπὸν τοῦτον, figuratively (cf. Deiss., BS, 238 f.; MM, xxiv; DB , iv, 427a), Rom.15:28; __(b) for concealment, hence, metaphorically, to hide (Da TH Da

G4973.definitionPl: σφραγίς , -ῖδος, ἡ [in LXX: Exo.28:11 , al. (חוֹתָם) Exo.35:22 (חָח), Sir.17:22 , al. ;] __1. a seal, signet : Rev.7:2. __2. The impression of a seal or signet, a seal (on its various purposes, see: σφραγίζω): on a book or roll, Rev.5:1-2, 5 5:9 6:1, 3 6:5, 7 6:9, 12 8:1 ; metaphorically, Rom.4:11 ,

G4974.definitionPl: σφυρόν , -οῦ, τό, [in LXX: Job.41:21 (לָהַט) * ;] the ankle : Act.3:7 , Rec. (T, WH, σφυδρόν; see Bl., § 6, 8).† (AS)

G4975.definitionPl: σχέδον adv. (ἔχω), [in LXX: 2Ma.5:2 , 3Ma.5:14 3Mac 5:45 * ;] __1. of place, near. __2. Of degree, almost, nearly : Act.13:44 19:26 , Heb.9:22 .† (AS)

G4976.definitionPl: σχῆμα , -τος, τό (ἔχω), [in LXX: Isa.3:17 (פֹּת) * ;] figure, fashion : 1Co.7:31 , Php.2:8 .† SYN. : see: μορφή (AS)

G4977.definitionPl: σχίζω [in LXX chiefly for בָּקַע ;] to cleave, rend : Mat.27:51 , Mrk.1:10 15:38 , Luk.5:36 23:45 , Jhn.19:24 21:11 ; metaphorically, in pass., to be divided into factions, Act.14:4 23:7 .† (AS)

G4978.definitionPl: σχίσμα , -τος, τό (σχίζω), a rent (Arist., al.): Mat.9:16 , Mrk.2:21 . Metaphorical, a dissension, division : Jhn.7:43 9:16 10:19 , 1Co.1:10 11:18 12:25 .† SYN. : see: αἵρεσις (AS)

G4979.definitionPl: σχοινίον , -ου, τό (dimin. of σχοῖνος, a rush), [in LXX chiefly for a rope (prop., one made of rushes): Jhn.2:15 , Act.27:32 .† (AS)

G4980.definitionPl: σχολάζω (σχολή), [in LXX: Exo.5:8, 17 , Psa.46:10 (רָפָה ni., hi.) * ;] to be at leisure, hence, to have time or opportunity for, to devote oneself to, be occupied in : 1Co.7:5; of things, to be unoccupied, empty (Plut., Eur., al.): οἶκος, Mat.12:44 , Luk.11:25 (T [WH], R, om.).† (AS)

G4981.definitionPl: σχολή , -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX: Gen.33:14 (κατὰ σ., אַט), Pro.28:19 , Sir.38:24 * ;] __1. leisure. __2. Later (from Plato on), __(a) that for which leisure is employed, a disputation, lecture ; __(b) the place where lectures are delivered, a school : Act.19:9 (for the later sense of employment, see MM, xxiv

G4982.definitionPl: σώζω (on the more accurate σῴζω, see WH, Intr. , §410; Bl., §3, 1-3), [in LXX chiefly for ישׁע hi., also for מלט ni., נצל ni., etc. ;] to save from peril, injury or suffering : Mat.8:25 , Mrk.13:20 , Luk.23:35 , al.; τ. ψυχήν, Mat.16:25 , al.; before ἐκ, Jhn.12:27 , Heb.5:7 , Ju 5 ; of healing, rest

G4983.definitionPl: σῶμα , -τος, τό, [in LXX for גְּוִיָּה ,בָּשָׂר, etc., and for Aram. נְבֵלָה ;] a body . __1. Prop., of the human body, __(a) as always in Hom. (opposite to δέμας), of the dead body: Mat.27:58, 59 Mrk.15:43 , al.; __(b) of the living body : Luk.11:34 , 1Co.6:13 , al.; ἐν σ. εἶναι, Heb.13:3; as the i

G4984.definitionPl: σωματικός , -ή, -όν (σῶμα), [in LXX: 4Ma.1:32 4Mac 3:1 * ;] __(a) of or for the body, bodily : γυμνασία, 1Ti.4:8; __(b) (opposite to ἀσώματος) bodily, corporeal : εἶδος, Luk.3:22. † (AS)

G4985.definitionPl: σωματικῶς adv. , bodily, corporeally : Col.2:9 (see ICC , Lft., in l).† (AS)

G4987.definitionPl: σωρεύω [in LXX: Pro.25:22 (חָתָה), Jdth.15:11 * ;] __(a) to heap on : with accusative before ἐπί with accusative, Rom.12:20 (LXX) (Arist., al.); __(b) to heap with : with accusative and dative, metaphorically, ἁμαρτίαις, 2Ti.3:6 (overwhelmed with, Field, Notes , 217) (Polyb.).† (AS)

G4988.definitionPl: Σωσθένης , -ου, ὁ Sosthenes ; __(a) a Jewish ruler : Act.18:7; __(b) a Christian : 1Co.1:1. † (AS)

G4990.definitionPl: σωτήρ , -ῆρος, ὁ (σώζω), [in LXX for יָשַׁע and cognate forms ;] saviour, deliverer, preserver, a frequently epithet of kings in the Ptolemaic and Rom. periods (Deiss., BS, 83; LAE , 368 f.; MM, xxiv), in NT, __(a) of God (as LXX: Psa.24:5 , Isa.12:2 , al.): Luk.1:47 , 1Ti.1:1 2:3 4:10 , Tit.1:3 2:1

G4991.definitionPl: σωτηρία , -ας, ἡ (σωτήρ), [in LXX for יֶשַׁע, יְשׁוּעָה, תְּשׁוּעָה, פְּלֵיטָה, etc. ;] deliverance, preservation, salvation, safety (Lat. salus): Act.7:25 27:34 , Heb.11:7 ; ἐξ ἐχθρῶν, Luk.1:71. In NT esp. of Messianic and spiritual salvation (see: σώζω): Luk.19:9 , Jhn.4:22 , Act.4:12 13:47 , Rom.

G4992.definitionPl: σωτήριος , -ον (σωτήρ), [in LXX for יְשׁוּעָה, שֶׁלֶם, etc. ;] saving, bringing salvation, in NT always in spiritual sense (see: σώζω, σωτηρία): ἡ χάρις ἡ σ., Tit.2:1. Neut., -τὸ σ., as subst. (cl.), salvation : Luk.2:30; τ. σ. τ. θεοῦ, Luk.3:6 , Act.28:28 ; περικεφαλαίαν τοῦ σ., Eph.6:17. † (AS)

G4993.definitionPl: σωφρονέω , -ῶ (σώφρων), __(a) to be of sound mind or in one's right mind : Mrk.5:15 , Luk.8:35 ; opposite to ἐκστῆναι, 2Co.5:13 (Hdt.); __(b) to be temperate, discreet, self-controlled (opposite to μαίνεσθαι, ὑβρίζειν, etc.; sch., Thuc., al.): Tit.2:6; opposite to ὑπερφρονεῖν, Rom.12:3; σ. καὶ νήφει

G4994.definitionPl: σωφρονίζω [in Aq.: Isa.38:16 * ;] to make σώφρων, recall one to his senses, control (RV, train): with accusative of person(s), Tit.2:4. † (AS)

G4995.definitionPl: σωφρονισμός , -οῦ, ὁ (σωφρονίζω), __(a) an admonishing (F1J, Plut., al.); __(b) self-control, self-discipline : 2Ti.1:7 (on the reflexive meaning here, see Ellic., in l).† (AS)

G4996.definitionPl: σωφρόνως adv. , [in LXX: Wis.9:11 * ;] with sound mind, prudently, soberly : Tit.2:12. † (AS)

G4997.definitionPl: σωφροσύνη , -ης, ἡ [in LXX: Est.3:13 , Wis.8:7 , 2Ma.4:37 , 4Ma.6:1-35 * ;] __(a) soundness of mind, good sense, sanity (opposite to μανία, Xen.): Act.26:25; __(b) self-control, sobriety : 1Ti.2:9 (see Tr., Syn. , § xx), 1Ti.2:15. † (AS)

G4998.definitionPl: σώφρων , -ον [in LXX: 4Ma.9:1-32 * ;] __(a) of sound mind, sane, sensible ; __(b) self-controlled, sober-minded : 1Ti.3:2 , Tit.1:8 2:2, 5 (Arist.).† (AS)

G4999.definitionPl: ταβέρνη (Lat. taberna), see: Τρεῖς Ταβέρναι. Τρεῖς Ταβέρναι (see: ταβέρνη), Three Taverns (Lit. Tres Tabernae) a halting place on the Appian Way: Act.28:15 (see DB , iv, 690).† (AS)

G5000.definitionPl: Ταβειθά (Rec. Ταβιθά), ἡ (Aram. טַבְיְתָא or טְבִיתָא), Tabitha : Act.9:36, 40 (cf. Δορκάς).† (AS)

G5001.definitionPl: τάγμα , -τος, τό (τάσσω), [in LXX chiefly for דֶּגֶל, also for חַי, רַגְלִי ;] that which has been arranged or placed in order ; esp. as military term, a company, troop, division, rank : metaphorically, 1Co.15:23 (see ICC , in l).† (AS)

G5002.definitionPl: τακτός , -ή, -όν (τάσσω), [in LXX: Job.12:5 (שַׁאֲנָן) * ;] ordered, fixed, stated : ἡμέρα, Act.12:21 ,† (AS)

G5003.definitionPl: ταλαιπωρέω , -ῶ (ταλαίπωρος), [in LXX Chiefly for שָׁדַד pu. ;] __1. to do hard labour, suffer hardship or distress : Jas.4:9. __2. In cl. occasionally trans., to weary, distress (so Psa.17:9 , Isa.33:1 ).† (AS)

G5004.definitionPl: ταλαιπωρία , -ας, ἡ (ταλαίπωρος) [in LXX chiefly for שֹׁד ;] __1. hard work (Hippocr.). __2. hardship, suffering, distress : Rom.3:16 (LXX) pl., Jas.5:1 (see B1., § 32, 6; WM, 220; Swete, Mk. , 153). (Hdt., Thuc., al.; and cf. MM, xxiv.)† (AS)

G5005.definitionPl: ταλαίωρος , -ον [in LXX: Psa.137:8 (שָׁדַד), Isa.33:1 (ποιεῖν τ., שָׁדַד), Tob.13:10 , Wis.3:11 , al. ;] distressed, miserable, wretched : Rom.7:24 , Rev.3:17 .† (AS)

G5006.definitionPl: ταλαντιαῖος , -α, -ον (τάλαντον), __(a) worth a talent ; __(b) of a talent's weight : Rev.16:21. † (AS)

G5007.definitionPl: τάλαντομ , -ον, τ [in LXX for כִּכָּר ;] __1. a balance (Hom.). __2. that which is weighed, a talent ; __(a) a talent in weight (in Horn. always of gold); __(b) a sum of money, whether gold or silver, equivalent to a talent in weight (see DB , iii, 418 ff.): Mat.18:24 25:15 ff.† (AS)

G5008.definitionPl: ταλειθά (Rec. ταλιθά), (Aram. טְלִיתָא, see Dalman, Gr. , 150), talitha, i.e. maiden: Mrk.5:41. † (AS)

G5009.definitionPl: ταμεῖον (late syncopated form of cl. ταμιεῖον; see M, Pr. , 44 f.; Bl., § 6, 5; Thackeray, Gr. , 63 ff.; Deiss., BS, 182 f.), -ον, τό, [in LXX chiefly for חֶדֶר ;] __1. a treasury (Thuc., al). __2. a store-chamber (Arist., Xen.; Deu.28:8 ): Luk.12:24 . __3. an inner chamber (Xen., Hell., v, 4, 5 Isa

G5010.definitionPl: τάξις , -εως, ἡ (τάσσω), [in LXX: Job.38:12 (מָקוֹם), Psa.110:4 (דִּבְרָה), 2Ma.9:18 , al. ;] __1. an arranging, hence, in military sense, disposition of an army, battle array (Thuc., al.). __2. arrangement, order (Plat., al): Luk.1:8. __3. due order : Col.2:5 ( ICC , in l); κατὰ τάξιν, 1Co.14:40. _

G5011.definitionPl: ταπεινός , -ή, -όν [in LXX for שָׁפָל, עָנִי, etc. ;] low-lying ; metaphorically, __(a) lowly, of low degree, brought low : Jas.1:9 , 2Co.7:6 (cf. Sir.25:23 ); οἱ τ., opposite to δυνάσται, Luk.1:52; τ. ταπεινοῖς (neut., R, txt.; masc., R, mg.; see ICC , in l), Rom.12:16; __(b) lowly in spirit, humbl

G5012.definitionPl: ταπεινοφροσύνη , -ης, ἡ (ταπεινόφρων) lowliness of mind, humility : Act.20:19 , Eph.4:2 , Php.2:3 , Col.3:12 , 1Pe.5:5 ; of a false humility, Col.2:18, 23 (rare outside of NT, but found in bad sense in FlJ, BJ, iv, 9, 2; also in Epictet., see Tr., Syn. , § xlii).† (AS)

G5013.definitionPl: ταπεινόω , -ῶ (ταπεινός), [in LXX chiefly for עָנָה, also for שָׁפֵל, כָּנַע, etc. ;] to make low : ὄρος (βουνόν), Luk.3:5 (LXX). Metaphorical, to humble, abase : Mat.18:4 23:12 , Luk.14:11 18:14 , 2Co.11:7 12:21 , Php.2:8 ; pass., Mat.23:12 , Luk.14:11 18:14 , Php.4:12 ; id. with mid. sense, Jas.4:

G5014.definitionPl: ταπείνωσις , -εως, ἡ (ταπεινόω), [in LXX chiefly for עֳנִי ;] abasement, humiliation, low estate : Luk.1:48 , Act.8:33 " (LXX), Php.3:21 , Jas.1:10 (Plat., Arist., and later writers).† (AS)

G5015.definitionPl: ταράσσω [in LXX for בָּהַל, רָגַז, etc., forty-six words in all ;] to disturb, trouble, stir up : primarily in physical sense (Hom., Eur.): τ. ὕδωρ, Jhn.1:5 [4], Jhn.1:7. Metaphorical, of the mind (Æsch., Plat., al.), to trouble, disquiet, perplex : Act.15:24 , Gal.1:7 5:10 ; ἑαυτόν (troubled himsel

G5016.definitionPl: ταραχή , -ῆς, ἡ (ταράσσω), [in LXX for חָלָה, מְהוּמָה, etc. ;] trouble, disturbance : τ. ὕδατος, Jhn.1:5 [4]. In pl. (as in cl.), tumults : Mrk.13:8 , Rec.† (AS)

G5017.definitionPl: τάραχος , -ου, ὁ (ταράσσω), [in LXX for מְהוּמָה, etc. ;] later form of ταραχή (Xen., al.; see Thackeray, Gr. , 159): Act.12:18 19:23 .† (AS)

G5019.definitionPl: Ταρσός , -oῦ Tarsus, a city of Cilicia : Act.9:30 11:25 22:3 .† (AS)

G5020.definitionPl: ταρταρόω , -ῶ (Τάρταρος, a Greek name for the underworld, esp. the abode of the damned), to cast into hell : 2Pe.2:4 (see Mayor, in l).† (AS)

G5021.definitionPl: τάσσω [in LXX chiefly for שׂוּם, also for צָוָה pi., נָתַן, etc. ;] primarily, in military sense, then generally, to draw up in order, arrange in place, assign, appoint, order : with dative (accusative) and inf. (Bl., § 72, 5), Act.15:2 18:2 (διατ-, WH) Act.22:10; ἑαυτούς, 1Co.16:15; pass., Mat.8:9

G5194.definitionPl: ὕαλος , -ου, ὁ [in LXX: Job.28:17 (זְכוּכִית) * ;] __1. (Hdt.) a clear transparent stone. __2. (from Plat. on) glass: Rev.21:18, 21 .† (AS)

G5195.definitionPl: ὑβρίζω (ὕβρις), [in LXX for גֵּאֶה, etc. ;] __1. intrans., to wax wanton, run riot. __2. Trans., to outrage, insult, treat insolently : with accusative of person(s), Mat.22:6 , Luk.11:45 18:32 , Act.14:5 , 1Th.2:2 .† (AS)

G5196.definitionPl: ὕβρις , -εως, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for גָּאוֹן and cogn. forms ;] __1. wantonness, insolence. __2. = ὕβρισμα, an act of wanton violence, an outrage, injury : 2Co.12:10; metaphorically, of a loss by sea (find.), Act.27:10, 21 (see MM, xxv).† (AS)

G5197.definitionPl: ὑβριστής , -οῦ, ὁ (ὑβρίζω), [in LXX chiefly for גֵּאֶה ;] a violent, insolent man : Rom.1:20 , 1Ti.1:13 (EV, injurious).† SYN. : ἀλαζών, ὑπερήφανος, see Tr., Syn. , § xxix (AS)

Epp. (as also in cl.) metaphorically, ὑ. ἐν τ. πίστει, Tit.1:13 ; τ. πίστει, τ. ἀγάπῃ , τ. ὑπομονῇ, Tit.2:2; ἡ ὑγιαίνουσα διδασκαλία, 1Ti.1:10 , 2Ti.4:3

G5199.definitionPl: ὑγιής , -ές, accusative, ὑγιῆ (Attic usually -ιᾶ), [in LXX for חַי, etc. ;] sound, whole, healthy : Mat.12:13 15:31 , Jhn.5:[4], 6, 9, 11, 14, 15 7:23, Act.4:10 ; before ἀπό, Mrk.5:34; of words, opinions, etc. (as in cl.), metaphorically, λόγος, Tit.2:8. † (AS)

G5357.definitionPl: φιάλη , -ης, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for מִזְרָק ;] a shallow bowl (= Lat. patera), used for pouring libations, etc.: Rev.5:8 15:7 16:1-17 17:1 21:9 .† (AS)

G5358.definitionPl: φιλ-άγαθος , -ον [in LXX: Wis.7:22 * ;] loving that which is good, loving goodness : Tit.1:8 (Arist., Polyb., a l.).† (AS)

G5359.definitionPl: Φιλαδελφία (Rec. -έλφεια), -ας, ἡ Philadelphia, a city of Lydia : Rev.1:11 3:7 .† (AS)

G5360.definitionPl: φιλαδελφία , -ας, ἡ (φιλάδελφος), [in LXX: 4Ma.13:23 4Mac 13:26 4Mac 14:1 * ;] the love of brothers, brotherly love : of Christians' mutual love as brethren (see: ἀδελφός), Rom.12:10 , 1Th.4:9 , Heb.13:1 , 1Pe.1:22 , 2Pe.1:7 .† (AS)

G5362.definitionPl: φίλανδρος , -ον __1. loving men (Æsch.). __2. Of a wife, loving her husband (frequently in epitaphs, see LS, see word, Deiss., BS, 255): Tit.2:4. † (AS)

G5363.definitionPl: φιλανθρωπία , -ας, ἡ (φιλάνθρωπος, humane), [in LXX: Est.8:13 , 2Ma.6:22 2Mac 14:9 , 3Ma.3:15 3Mac 3:18 * ;] humanity, kindness (see Field, Notes , 147 f.): Act.28:2 , Tit.3:4 (cf. also DCG , ii, 356 ff.).† (AS)

G5364.definitionPl: φιλανθρώπως adv. , [in LXX: 2Ma.9:27 , 3Ma.3:20 * ;] humanely, kindly : Act.27:3. † (AS)

G5365.definitionPl: φιλαργυρία , -ας, ἡ (φιλάργυρος), [in LXX: 4Ma.1:26 4Mac 2:15 א1 * ;] love of money, avarice : 1Ti.6:1. † SYN. : πλεονεξία, covetousness (see Tr., Syn. , § xxiv) (AS)

G5366.definitionPl: φιλ-άργυρος , -ον [in LXX: 4Ma.2:8 * ;] loving money, avaricious : Luk.16:14 , 2Ti.3:2 .† (AS)

G5367.definitionPl: φίλ-αυτος , -ον loving oneself (Arist.); in bad sense (ib.), selfish : 2Ti.3:2. † SYN. : αὐθάδης (see Tr., Syn. , § xciii) (AS)

G5375.definitionPl: φίλιπποι , -ων, οἱ (on the pl., see WM, § 27, 3) Philippi : Act.16:12 20:6 , Php.1:1 , 1Th.2:2 .† (AS)
